title: FREE REQUEST Looking for people to check the English translation

posts.author: GoldSmeargle
posts.body:
Hello everyone! I'm part of a team of three developers that have finished to develop a game made with RPG Maker VX Ace. We have translated the game to English and are looking for some people to play the game and check the translation.
What's the project?
The game is "The Elquest - The Legend of Immortal Dremond" and we'd like to release it at the end of February on Steam. A Steam page is already available online and you'll find more information on it. It's a classic RPG game in which you have to fight monsters and solve mysteries and puzzles to go on in the adventure. The characters are pretty nice, the story is cool and fun, and we put a lot of attention in almost everything, from the fighting system to the music.
Why are we looking for you?
I'm not a native speaker and, although I put a lot of attention in my translation, I know that I could have made mistakes. That's why I need some natives, or people that speak English frequently, to play the game and report me weird sentences or grammar mistakes, giving me also advice when needed.
What do you get?
You'll be able to play the game for free! The game is complete and you can enjoy the whole adventure. Moreover, your name will appear in the game credits (if you want) when it is published on Steam.
Feel free to ask questions. If you want to help us, reply to this thread and tell me a bit about you
Thank you!
